 'GTA VI' reportedly has 62 types of birds to spot in a wildlife logbook across the game world of Leonida
 By
 Ryan Gaydos Fox News 
 Published
 November 17, 2026 8:52am EST Comments

 close Video Grand Theft Auto VI raises concerns over violent content 
 Fox News contributors Ben Domenech and Joe Concha discuss the role of parents in regulating childhood media consumption amid the release of the new Grand Theft Auto video game.
 "Grand Theft Auto VI" is one of the most highly anticipated video games of the last decade, taking players on a reimagined look of Vice City and beyond.
 The game specifically allows players to commit an assortment of crimes to complete extraneous tasks. You can have an array of weapons at your disposal, steal almost any car you desire and rob non-playable characters to boost your virtual bank accounts – all of which is incredibly fun and is definitely not a reflection of society at all, believe me.
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK OUTDOORS COVERAGE 
 A billboard for the video game "Grand Theft Auto VI" is pictured above Hollywood Boulevard on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello) 
 However, a specific group of people are looking forward to the game for a different reason.
 Rockstar Games gave The Guardian an initial look at the gameplay. Tucked into the review is one thing the characters – Jason and Lucia – can do that doesn’t involve killing, robbing or having sex with a prostitute. Bird watch.
 At one point in the review, the writer watches Jason pull out a pair of binoculars to look at a gull. The action is then recorded in a wildlife logbook that the users get to fill over the course of the game. The Guardian reported there are 62 different types of birds spotted in the world known in the game as Leonida.
 THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! 
 A poster for the Grand Theft Auto VI video game, which will be released on Nov. 19, 2026, is displayed at a GameStop store on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026, in Colma, Calif. (AP Photo/Jeff Chiu) 
 Needless to say, the birding community is pumped.
 The hobbyists who take great pride in watching and spotting birds out in the wild in real life seemed excited about this feature and made it known on Reddit .
 "Well now I know my plans for the first week of playing: get Lucia as many cute outfits as possible to go birdwatching in. The story & heists & Jason can wait," user cosmicsloth47 wrote.
 "I feel like such a dork being excited for the wildlife in a GTA game of all places but I truly am excited to see it all LOL," user juiceboxes__ added.
 "GTA 6 has even invaded birdwatching. This is insane," user IronMan319 added.
 "I’m so hyped. Probably the first thing i do if we’re given the binoculars right away," user cambino commented.
 There are hundreds of comments just like that on Reddit. Sometimes, it’s the little things that can really make a game great.
 Rockstar Games’ "Red Dead Redemption 2" had a similar function but the animals were primarily being hunted. The wildlife changed as you moved across the map.
